_comment: Editable page text in English (en) and Malay (ms). Historical claims belong in events.json and ship.json, not here. Have Malay text reviewed by a fluent speaker before publishing. Verified_First: the public data contains only records and details supported by their cited sources; everything else is in research/data.
Institution_Name: KD Hang Tuah Digital Maritime Museum
Institution_Note: A student heritage documentation project. Not an official publication of the Royal Malaysian Navy.

Home_Coordinates.Label: Lumut Naval Base, Perak
Home_Coordinates.Note: Provisional coordinates for Lumut Naval Base, taken from Wikipedia and not independently verified. The museum's future berth has not been published.

en.demo_notice: Research edition. Each record shows its sources and verification status; some claims are still being checked.
en.hero_intro: Built on the Clyde as Ghana's Black Star, commissioned in the Royal Navy as HMS Mermaid, and from 1977 to 2025 the Royal Malaysian Navy's KD Hang Tuah: one ship, three names, nearly five decades under the Malaysian flag.
en.home_story_body: The timeline gathers the events of the ship's life that are confirmed by their sources, each with its citations. Events whose sources disagree, or that are not yet confirmed, are kept in the project's research register and are not shown.
en.home_voyage_body: Follow the ship's 1977 voyage home from Portsmouth to Malaysia, as documented on a panel on board. Only confirmed ports are marked; the lines between them are schematic.
en.home_onboard_body: The bridge, the mess decks, the engine room. A catalogue of the ship's spaces, recorded deck by deck during a site visit. Photographs will be added once they are approved.
en.home_legacy_body: Decommissioned on 3 December 2025 and handed to the Perak state government in July 2026, the ship is being prepared as the Memorial Muzium Kapal Diraja Hang Tuah in Lumut, planned to open in 2027.
en.story_intro: The confirmed events of the ship's life, in order. Filter by period or theme, or search by name and place. Each record shows its sources.
en.voyage_intro: Press Play to follow KD Hang Tuah from Portsmouth to Woodlands in 1977. Only ports named in the panel text on board and confirmed are shown; dashed lines are schematic and show sequence, not the exact track.
en.ship_intro: The vessel's identity, specifications and service record, laid out as a ship's record card. Fields without a confirmed source are marked as pending.
en.onboard_intro: A catalogue of the ship's spaces and fittings. Select any item to see its photographs at full size.
en.legacy_intro: From front-line frigate to memorial museum.
en.legacy_body: Declared the navy's museum ship in November 2018 while still in commission, KD Hang Tuah was decommissioned on 3 December 2025 and handed to the Perak state government on 27 July 2026. The museum project is a public–private partnership between MB Inc. and Aero Art Sdn Bhd.
en.visit_body: The museum is not yet open. The Perak state government has announced a planned opening in 2027. Opening hours, admission and contact details will appear here once they are officially published.
en.sources_intro: The sources this site relies on, and further references that are listed but not relied on.

ms.demo_notice: Edisi penyelidikan. Setiap rekod menunjukkan sumber dan status pengesahannya; sebahagian dakwaan masih sedang disemak.
ms.hero_intro: Dibina di Clyde sebagai Black Star untuk Ghana, ditauliahkan dalam Tentera Laut Diraja British sebagai HMS Mermaid, dan dari 1977 hingga 2025 berkhidmat sebagai KD Hang Tuah dalam Tentera Laut Diraja Malaysia: sebuah kapal, tiga nama, hampir lima dekad di bawah bendera Malaysia.
ms.home_story_body: Garis masa ini mengumpulkan peristiwa dalam riwayat kapal yang disahkan oleh sumbernya, berserta rujukannya. Peristiwa yang sumbernya bercanggah atau belum disahkan disimpan dalam daftar penyelidikan projek dan tidak dipaparkan.
ms.home_voyage_body: Ikuti pelayaran pulang kapal ini dari Portsmouth ke Malaysia pada 1977, seperti yang didokumentasikan pada panel di atas kapal. Hanya pelabuhan yang disahkan ditanda; garisan di antaranya adalah skematik.
ms.home_onboard_body: Anjungan, dek makan, bilik enjin. Katalog ruang kapal, direkodkan dek demi dek semasa lawatan ke kapal. Gambar akan ditambah setelah diluluskan.
ms.home_legacy_body: Dilucutkan tauliah pada 3 Disember 2025 dan diserahkan kepada Kerajaan Negeri Perak pada Julai 2026, kapal ini sedang disediakan sebagai Memorial Muzium Kapal Diraja Hang Tuah di Lumut, yang dijangka dibuka pada 2027.
ms.story_intro: Peristiwa yang disahkan dalam riwayat kapal, mengikut urutan. Tapis mengikut tempoh atau tema, atau cari mengikut nama dan tempat. Setiap rekod menunjukkan sumbernya.
ms.voyage_intro: Tekan Main untuk mengikuti KD Hang Tuah dari Portsmouth ke Woodlands pada 1977. Hanya pelabuhan yang dinamakan dalam teks panel di atas kapal dan telah disahkan dipaparkan; garisan putus-putus adalah skematik dan menunjukkan urutan, bukan laluan sebenar.
ms.ship_intro: Identiti, spesifikasi dan rekod perkhidmatan kapal, dalam bentuk kad rekod kapal. Maklumat tanpa sumber yang disahkan ditanda sebagai belum disahkan.
ms.onboard_intro: Katalog ruang dan kelengkapan kapal. Pilih mana-mana item untuk melihat gambarnya dalam saiz penuh.
ms.legacy_intro: Daripada frigat barisan hadapan kepada muzium memorial.
ms.legacy_body: Diisytiharkan sebagai kapal muzium TLDM pada November 2018 ketika masih bertauliah, KD Hang Tuah dilucutkan tauliah pada 3 Disember 2025 dan diserahkan kepada Kerajaan Negeri Perak pada 27 Julai 2026. Projek muzium ini ialah kerjasama awam-swasta antara MB Inc. dan Aero Art Sdn Bhd.
ms.visit_body: Muzium ini belum dibuka. Kerajaan Negeri Perak telah mengumumkan jangkaan pembukaan pada 2027. Waktu dibuka, bayaran masuk dan maklumat hubungan akan dipaparkan di sini setelah diterbitkan secara rasmi.
ms.sources_intro: Sumber yang dijadikan sandaran oleh laman ini, dan rujukan lanjut yang disenaraikan tetapi tidak dijadikan sandaran.

Planned_Opening.Title: Planned opening as the Memorial Muzium Kapal Diraja Hang Tuah
Planned_Opening.Title_MS: Pembukaan yang dirancang sebagai Memorial Muzium Kapal Diraja Hang Tuah
Planned_Opening.Text: Reports of the July 2026 handover say the ship is planned to open to the public as a memorial museum at Lumut in 2027. This is an announced plan, not a completed event; opening details have not been published.
Planned_Opening.Text_MS: Laporan penyerahan pada Julai 2026 menyatakan bahawa kapal ini dirancang dibuka kepada orang awam sebagai muzium memorial di Lumut pada 2027. Ini ialah rancangan yang diumumkan, bukan peristiwa yang telah berlaku; butiran pembukaan belum diterbitkan.
